description: Static performance leads distilled from web.dev and Lighthouse documentation (CC-BY, Google). Leads only: a performance finding still requires a runtime receipt under the audit contract.

rules.message: Image without width and height reserves no space and shifts layout when it loads.
rules.false_positive_guard: Images sized by CSS aspect-ratio or fixed containers are fine; confirm shift by operating before reporting.

rules.message: Script in head without defer/async/module blocks first paint.
rules.false_positive_guard: Tiny inline-critical loaders are sometimes deliberate; confirm with a trace before reporting.

rules.message: No viewport meta: mobile renders a scaled desktop layout.
rules.false_positive_guard: Intranet desktop-only tools may omit it deliberately; confirm the audience first.

rules.message: A very large base64 payload is inlined into the document.
rules.false_positive_guard: Self-contained single-file deliverables inline payloads by design; confirm the surface is a served page.
